label: Replenishment permits constant nondepleting interval work, by temporal energy accounting (inference)
rule: Finite summation and real Archimedean order
meaning: At every natural interval the explicit ledger (2,2,1,1,0) is admissible and its unit work meets unit demand. This is a replenished ledger control, not physical dynamics. Analyst conditional energy accounting only; no causal or bearer bridge.
